name: PT Transcoal Pacific Tbk
summary: PT Transcoal Pacific Tbk, a shipping company, provides vessel charter and goods freight services in Indonesia. It operates through Sea Transportation Business and Other Business Activities segments. The company offers maritime transportation services for coal, nickel, industrial diesel, and crude palm oil; transshipment services for bulk goods; assist tug rental services; floating barges for terminal storage of fuel oil; and mooring man and oil spill response team services, as well as barging, long hauling, floating terminal station, mother vessel, and agency services.
